name: Oyaji no Hitomi ni Koishiteru!?
original_name: オヤジの瞳に恋してる！？
source:
The protagonist is a 2nd year university student.
One day she meets a bunch of old guys by chance, and gets wrapped up in a plan to revitalize the shopping district.
